# agentic-publish

Route social posts across Content Rabbit, Zernio, Ayrshare, and direct APIs.

Keywords: social, publish, private-repo-c4e6, zernio, ayrshare.

- SDK: import { publishPost, defaultAdapters } from "agentic-publish".
- CLI: agentic-publish publish --text "..." --targets x.
- MCP: run agentic-publish mcp, then call publish_post.
- Facebook Page: FacebookPageProvider posts to /{page-id}/feed with an injected token resolver.
  Dry run is the default. Live needs dryRun false, an approval hook, and live: true.
  Post keys make retries safe. planDaily() and runFacebookDaily() run one cron tick.
  CLI: agentic-publish facebook publish|daily. MCP: facebook_page_publish, facebook_daily.
